LMHC.name: LMHC - Licensed Mental Health Counselor

requirements.name: Professional Ethics & Law
requirements.description: 6 hours of professional ethics and law required every 2-year renewal cycle.

requirements.name: Professional Roles & Boundaries
requirements.description: Minimum 2 hours of Professional Roles & Boundaries every 2 years, taken separately from the 6 ethics and law hours (WAC 246-809-630).

requirements.name: Health Equity Continuing Education
requirements.anchorLabel: Last Health Equity Training Date (4-Yr Cycle)
requirements.description: Minimum 2 hours required at least once every 4 years (WAC 246-12-820 and 246-809-630).

requirements.name: Suicide Assessment, Treatment & Management
requirements.description: Minimum 6 hours from the WA DOH Model List required at least once every 6 years.

citations: WAC 246-809-630: Continuing education requirements for Licensed Counselor (LMHC, LMFT, LICSW) — 32 hours every 2 years, including 6 hours in professional ethics and law plus at least 2 separate hours in professional roles and boundaries (amended by WSR 25-11-019, effective October 1, 2025).
WAC 246-809-615: Suicide assessment, treatment, and management training — 6 hours every 6 years.
WAC 246-12-800 to 246-12-830: Health equity continuing education — 2 hours every 4 years.

requirements.name: Suicide Assessment, Treatment & Management

citations: WAC 246-809-632: Associate continuing education — 16 hours every year, including 6 hours of ethics and law every 2 years and at least 2 separate hours in professional roles and boundaries (effective October 1, 2025).
